answers.how: The ruler's 1 cm graduations span approximately 40 pixels. The block's front horizontal edge spans about 490 pixels: 490/40 ≈ 12.3 cm.
The block's front face is approximately 98 pixels thick. Using 40 pixels per centimetre gives 98/40 = 2.45 cm.
The pencil tip moves approximately 553 pixels between 2.280 s and 3.400 s. Its average speed is 553/(40 × 1.120) ≈ 12.3 cm/s.
The saw blade moves approximately 510 pixels across the block between 7.960 s and 17.080 s. Its average cutting speed is 510/(40 × 9.120) ≈ 1.4 cm/s.
